filesystem.instructions: Lists and reads the files of the project workspace.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List every file in the workspace (relative paths).

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a text file from the workspace by relative path.

grep.instructions: Searches the text of every workspace file for a regular expression.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search all workspace files for a regex; returns `path:line: text` for each matching line.

git.instructions: Reads the git history of the workspace repository (log, show).

tools.name: git_log
tools.description: Commit history (hash, author, date, subject), newest first; optionally only commits touching `path`.

tools.name: git_show
tools.description: Show one commit: metadata and the list of files it changed.

sqlite.instructions: Runs read-only SQL queries against the project database data.db.

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: List the tables of the database with their CREATE statements.

tools.name: query
tools.description: Run a read-only SQL SELECT and return the rows as text.

fetch.instructions: Fetches a web page by URL (the company intranet) and returns its text.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: HTTP GET a URL and return the page as plain text (HTML tags stripped).

notes.instructions: Searches the team's shared notes (rotations, runbooks, decisions).

tools.name: list_notes
tools.description: List the titles of all team notes.

tools.name: search_notes
tools.description: Full-text search over the team notes; returns matching notes (title and body).

python.instructions: Executes a Python snippet in an isolated sandbox (no access to the workspace files) and returns its output.

tools.name: run_python
tools.description: Run Python code in a fresh interpreter (10 s limit); returns stdout and stderr. The sandbox cannot see workspace files: pass data in the code itself.

pytest.instructions: Runs the project's test suite and reports the results.

tools.name: run_tests
tools.description: Run `pytest` in the workspace (optionally with extra arguments, e.g. a path or -k expr); returns the summary.

lint.instructions: Runs the static linter (pyflakes) on a workspace file and reports every warning.

tools.name: lint
tools.description: Lint one Python file (relative path) with pyflakes; returns the warnings and their count.

write_file.instructions: Creates or overwrites a text file in the project workspace.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Write `content` to the workspace file at the relative `path` (parent directories are created).

mail.instructions: Sends e-mail from the agent's company mailbox.

tools.name: send_mail
tools.description: Send an e-mail to the address `to` with the given subject and body.

ticket.instructions: Creates tickets in the team's issue tracker.

tools.name: create_ticket
tools.description: Open a new ticket in the issue tracker with the given title and description.
